title: Apply to be on a priority waiting list for a commercial mooring licence
summary: Apply to join a priority waiting list for a commercial mooring licence if none are currently available in your preferred area.
intro: If you're wanting a commercial mooring licence, but none are available in your preferred mooring area, you can apply to be on the priority waiting list for that area. You'll then be notified when a mooring site becomes available.
who_can_apply: The business provides marine-type services to the boating public.
The business can only be accessed by water.
The applicant is a registered club or association.
what_you_need: Completed application form (either for initial or transfer of a commercial mooring licence).
Proof of identity for the business and the nominated representative.
Written authorisation from the nominated representative on business or club letterhead.
A detailed description of the proposed usage of the mooring site on business letterhead.

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by post or email to the details on the form.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a commercial mooring licence waiting list?
faqs.a: You can apply if your business provides marine-type services to the boating public, if your business can only be accessed by water, or if you are a registered club or association.

faqs.q: How do I submit my application?
faqs.a: You can submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by post or email using the details provided on the form.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need the application form, proof of identity for the business and nominated representative, written authorisation on business/club letterhead, and a detailed description of your proposed usage.
